'''Licia Macchini''' (11 July 1930 – 29 November 2018)<ref name="Obituary">[https://www.ilcittadino.it/sport/2018/11/29/addio-a-licia-macchini/iaFmw0fNn6Yn6cFq9SIrx3/index.html Licia Macchini's obituary] {{in lang|it}}</ref> was an [[Artistic gymnastics|artistic gymnast]]. She competed at the [[1948 Summer Olympics|1948]] and [[1952 Summer Olympics]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20200418001845/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ma/licia-macchini-1.html "Licia Macchini"]. sports-reference.com. Retrieved 27 May 2013.</ref> She was an Italian gymnast born in Lodi. She was a member of the Fanfulla club under coach Riccardo Fraschini. She was Italian champion in the all-around in 1950, but her greatest sporting success came at the 1950 World Championships in [[Basel]], when she won two bronze medals. She won the first bronze medal individually in the [[balance beam]] and the second with the Italian team.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Olympedia – Licia Macchini |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/28716 |access-date=2023-10-22 |website=www.olympedia.org}}</ref>
